2166.note_text: (1) Principally, a fault is the result of an undesired change of data contained in or flowing through an electronic measuring instrument. (2) From the definition it follows that in this Document, a “fault” is a numerical value which is expressed either in a unit of measurement or as a relative value, for instance as a percentage.

2164.note_text: difference between the error of indication and the intrinsic error of a measuring instrument
